previously_inspected.basis: All31 previously had generic arrival/following force-status inspection. Only the5 nonzero attacker-survivor cases (precisely the original mismatches) entered the old source=target/new-leg scan and already had NEW_LEG_COMPATIBLE_OWNER_AND_SURVIVOR_VECTOR. The remaining26 had route/alias inspection, not exhaustive outgoing accounting. Independence is therefore reduced, especially for the5 mismatch explanations.

population.selection_rule: Exactly the prior31 unique COMBAT_REQUIRED cases; symmetric replay without filtering original outcomes. Legacy4 remain aliases and add0.

qualification.rules: Unchanged prior hostility-known, inbound-complete, production/aura/special/delay/capacity/continuity guards. Recompute only with existing frozen scorer and assert per-case agreement; no relaxation, reachability exclusion, or repaired endpoint.

continuation_accounting_definition: Predicted owner must equal observed owner AND predicted survivor vector must equal observed inventory + SUM(all compatible newly observable outgoing at offset0). Preserve partial retained inventory and partial outgoing; no subset search, clipping, or outgoing==survivor requirement. Known source-target oversized vectors stay included as counterexamples.
compatible_outgoing_definition: Same first-retained document/match/player/time-origin scope and arrival tick; known source==combat target, known owner==observed post-combat owner, complete known nonnegative typed vector. Destination may remain UNKNOWN. No amount/budget filter. Count new signature multiplicity above before baseline, using owner/source/destination/vector; IDs supplemental only. Same signature persisting across frames is not counted again. Unknown before endpoint/vector aliases flag uncertain first appearance.
unknown_policy: Missing/incomplete census or plausible same-observed-owner unknown source/owner/vector prevents complete NO or complete accounting; never substitute zero. Preserve a separate observed-only arithmetic result. Do not use formula survivor size to discard unknown-source aliases. Relevant before-alias uncertainty also remains UNKNOWN. Known owner mismatch or known vector contradiction is a true mismatch only if relevant accounting inputs are complete.
